key.scheme_identity:
scheme-expression-v1
(fix
  (roles (domino offer))
  (out offer)
  (case
    (offer-count-to-partner offer))
)
registry: [PredicateSpec { name: "offer-count-to-partner", version: "gym-v1", parameters: [Domino], horizon_plies: 1, access: Viewer }]

query_match.identity:
scheme-expression-v1
(fix
  (roles (domino action))
  (out action)
  (case
    (own-legal action))
)
registry: [PredicateSpec { name: "own-legal", version: "scheme-v1/straight-v0.4", parameters: [Domino], horizon_plies: 0, access: Viewer }]

semantics.belief: Uniform over every mechanically compatible current deal; no pre-root policy likelihood.
semantics.continuation: Full legal focal best response, one action per focal information state; future field-action conditioning.
semantics.count: Diagnostic only; after contract settles the extracted focal policy completes with lowest legal plays.
semantics.field: Fixed seat-local L1 fixed/voidless teammate, L0 opponents; deterministic declared state seed.
semantics.grading: Root-action regret with optimal focal continuation; not the pupil's complete policy value.
semantics.objective: Viewer's team makes or sets bid 30; every equal success mass ties.
